requirements.subject: federation
requirements.statement: The federation must document its agreed exchanged data in an OMT FOM.
requirements.conditions: For an HLA federation; the FOM is composed from one or more FOM modules and one MIM.
open_items: These paths consume federation models; they do not establish completeness or correctness of a federation author's declarations.
Review each claimed federation model against its exchange agreement and the applicable OMT content rules; no dedicated model-author oracle is linked.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Joined federates, rather than the RTI, must maintain simulation-associated instance attribute values.
requirements.conditions: Simulation state, not federation MOM state; RTI retention or use of data to provide its services is not itself simulation-model maintenance.
open_items: Determine and review the particular federates in the claim; server routing or checkpoint tests cannot prove their simulation-state responsibility.
No independent federate-state ownership oracle is linked.

requirements.subject: federation
requirements.statement: A given object instance attribute must never have more than one joined-federate owner simultaneously.
requirements.conditions: Throughout a federation execution, including ownership transfers; the rule allows an attribute to have no joined-federate owner.
open_items: The linked local transfer case is not proof of the invariant over every concurrent acquisition, divestiture, resign, deletion, and restore path.
Inventory independent concurrent negative cases and standard-Java ownership client cases; none is linked for this row.
This is a federation rule with an RTI enforcement surface, not a whole ownership-clause verdict.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: A federate must document its externally available information in an OMT SOM.
requirements.conditions: For each claimed HLA federate; the SOM uses one or more SOM modules and may include a MIM.
open_items: Identify the claimed federates and their SOM artifacts; no federate-specific SOM completeness assessment is linked.
An RTI FOM parser test does not discharge the federate developer's SOM responsibility.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: A federate must manage its local time according to its federation's selected time-management approach.
requirements.conditions: The federation designers choose the approach; no particular time-advance choreography is universally imposed by this rule.
open_items: Identify the federation time agreement and assess each claimed federate against it.
No dedicated federate-policy or policy-violation test is linked; RTI time-service tests are a different responsibility.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Creation must reject an execution name that already identifies an existing federation execution.
requirements.conditions: A connected caller invokes Create Federation Execution for an existing execution name, with otherwise admissible inputs.
open_items: The independent Python case verifies the connected-call rejection and original class usability, not exact exclusion of all competitor module content; standard-Java exception translation is a separate binding assessment. Execution evidence is imported separately.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Destruction must reject a federation execution that still has joined federates.
requirements.conditions: A connected caller invokes Destroy Federation Execution for an existing execution with at least one joined member.
open_items: The independent Python case verifies joined rejection, continuing membership, successful empty destruction and recreation; standard-Java exception translation is a separate binding assessment. Execution evidence is imported separately.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: The RTI must automatically load the standard MIM when creation supplies no explicit MIM.
requirements.conditions: Create Federation Execution with otherwise compliant supplied FOM modules and an omitted MIM argument.
open_items: Link a focused public-create oracle that checks actual standard MOM declarations, not only a MIM label or digest.
The repository's empty-module shortcut requires separate admission review; no missing-FOM negative case is linked, and the at-least-one-FOM obligation is not inventoried here.
Independent and standard-Java default-MIM cases are not linked.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Creation must reject the reserved explicit MIM designator HLAstandardMIM.
requirements.conditions: An explicit MIM argument equals the exact reserved designator; a filename with a suffix is not that same designator.
open_items: Review public standard-binding exception identity and unchanged state on rejection; this local negative link does not establish end-to-end conformance.
No independent or standard-Java reserved-MIM case is linked.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Deletion must reject an object instance that is not known to the invoking joined federate.
requirements.conditions: A connected joined caller invokes Delete Object Instance for an instance it does not know; global RTI existence alone does not establish caller knowledge.
open_items: The independent Python case distinguishes existing-but-undiscovered, known-but-nonowner and already-deleted instances and verifies continued updates and the eventual owner deletion. No universal exception-precedence rule is inferred; standard-Java translation remains a separate binding assessment.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Lookup of an object-class name not defined in the FDD must report the appropriate lookup error, represented as NameNotFound in the incorporated standard Java API.
requirements.conditions: Get Object Class Handle is invoked by name in an otherwise legal service state; this is not the by-handle ObjectClassNotDefined lookup. Python product interfaces are assessed separately from the standardized language mapping.
open_items: Historical actual-server runs reproduced SyncPointNotFound. The 2026-10-01 follow-up repairs the Python public mapping, adds a server NameNotFound trailer and reruns real TCP contracts; see ieee1516-2010-sdk-gap-fixes-20261001.md for candidate hashes and bounded execution evidence. This inventory remains source links, not an automatic closure verdict.

Separately execute the selected standard Java API case and the remaining applicable service states and exceptions. Passing Python product tests do not establish complete standardized Java mapping conformance.

The earlier exploratory ObjectClassNotFound exact-name expectation was incorrect; Annex B's supplied Java API and the C++ API both identify NameNotFound for this by-name service. API/member/source hashes are retained in the private gap findings.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Accepted FDD contributions must remain available for the lifetime of the federation execution after their contributing federates resign.
requirements.conditions: A compliant additional FOM module has been accepted on join; resignation is not destruction of the federation execution.
open_items: The independent Python case verifies contribution retention and usability after all members resign. Contribution absence after recreation, arbitrary module merge compatibility and standard-Java translation require separate evidence.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Transportation description differences alone must not cause RTI module combination to fail.
requirements.conditions: Create or additional-module join combines compliant declarations with identical transportation name and reliability; the description is outside FDD.
open_items: First-description retention is implementation policy, not the obligation recorded here.
Independently review reliability-conflict negative cases and public create/join atomicity; local parser links do not prove every admission path.
No independent public-client or standard-Java module-combination case is linked.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Update-rate description differences alone must not cause RTI module combination to fail.
requirements.conditions: Create or additional-module join combines compliant declarations with identical update-rate name and exact maximum rate; descriptive fields are outside the listed FDD rate columns.
open_items: Independently review unequal exact-rate negative cases and public create/join atomicity; rounded numeric equality must not replace exact decimal comparison.
No independent public-client or standard-Java module-combination case is linked; descriptive retention policy is not mandated by this row.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: An implemented C++ or Java API must provide the HLAinteger64Time logical-time implementation based on HLAinteger64BE.
requirements.conditions: For each C++ or Java API included in the supported claim; this does not require every RTI to implement both language APIs.
open_items: The linked standard-Java factory-discovery case is only a local subset; missing independent standard-Java runtime and encoding cases remain to be linked.
Link literal C++ behavioral case names and independently review big-endian vectors, unsupported selection, boundary arithmetic, and factory-to-runtime composition.
Factory/header presence is not full logical-time correctness.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: An implemented C++ or Java API must provide the HLAfloat64Time logical-time implementation based on HLAfloat64BE.
requirements.conditions: For each C++ or Java API included in the supported claim; providing integer64 does not replace this representation.
open_items: The linked standard-Java enumeration case is only a local subset; missing independent standard-Java runtime and encoding cases remain to be linked.
Link literal C++ behavioral case names and independently review big-endian vectors, invalid values, boundary arithmetic, and runtime factory selection.
The separate epsilon and arithmetic obligations are not closed or fully inventoried by a representation-availability row.

requirements.subject: federation
requirements.statement: Each declared maximum update rate must be a strictly positive decimal value measured in hertz.
requirements.conditions: A federation FOM or FOM module declares an update-rate entry; XML lexical validity alone is insufficient. The same model-content rule also applies to SOM entries, which require a separate federate assessment.
open_items: These links concern local RTI ingestion of the model-content obligation, not the correctness of every supplied federation model.
Independently review zero, negative, signed-zero, and extremely small positive decimal cases across public admission paths; no independent or standard-Java case is linked.
Do not equate a product numeric range restriction with the standard's positivity condition.

requirements.subject: omt-tool
requirements.statement: A claimed conforming OMT tool must accept and parse any conforming object model's XML product form.
requirements.conditions: Only for a component claimed as an OMT object-model tool; the full OMT model domain is broader than RTI FDD consumption.
open_items: Decide whether any gorti component is claimed as a conforming OMT tool; mapped parser files are candidate review surfaces, not an applicability conclusion.
No full-OMT acceptance corpus or independent tool oracle is linked; an FDD subset parser is not automatically a conforming OMT tool.
Inventory invalid-input negative cases separately; this row records acceptance of conforming models only.

requirements.subject: omt-tool
requirements.statement: A claimed conforming OMT tool with XML output must express the object model in valid XML.
requirements.conditions: Only for an OMT-tool claim whose component provides XML output; RTI FDD export and full OMT XML-product conformance are distinct scopes.
open_items: Decide the OMT-tool and XML-output claim before assigning this requirement to the RTI exporter.
No independent full-OMT XML-output oracle is linked; validation against the relaxed FDD schema does not establish full OMT XML-product conformance.
The separate user-input diagnostics and Annex E schema obligations are not inventoried by this atomic XML-output row.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: An RTI claiming HLA conformance must implement every joined-federate-initiated service specified by the interface standard.
requirements.conditions: For a full RTI conformance claim, with the supported language API and platform profile explicitly identified; this seed inventory does not define or establish that claim.
open_items: Resolve the intended claim and supported standard API profile; Go/Python product APIs do not substitute for the language mapping requirement.
Enumerate remaining service obligations atomically; RTI-initiated callbacks, at least one standard language API, mapping, and certification provisions need separate rows.
All tests entries in this inventory are source links only, not runtime evidence, PASS verdicts, coverage measures, or closure claims.
Independent public-client, negative-service, and complete standard-Java evidence remain unestablished by this seed; existing Java subset links do not establish whole-binding conformance.
No full-clause completion or HLA Conforming label is asserted; separately assess the publicly certified-results condition in Clause 13.
